list: the official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18 (Exophase + PSNProfiles, agreeing on every name, description and grade)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no online trophy and no DLC requirement, so one single-player playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole run 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn every other trophy in this list.
No online play is needed: all 55 are offline.
The hardest single step is A Long Road (100% completion).

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
It pops automatically at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 1, which ends after you complete the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through Chapter 1.
Start Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?) and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Chapter 2 ends when you complete the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through Chapter 2.
Start Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City) and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Chapter 3 ends after you complete the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through Chapter 3.
Complete Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Chapter 4 ends when you complete its final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through Chapter 4.
Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the game. The final mission is Starting From Zero, the same mission that closes Chapter 4. After the ending you keep free-roam, so nothing is lost.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero.
Free-roam stays open afterwards for cleanup.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission; the trophy pops when you finish it.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.
It pops automatically at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 main mission; finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
It pops automatically at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission; finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
It pops automatically at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission; finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
It pops automatically at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 main mission; finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
It pops automatically at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission; finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
It pops automatically at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the backbone of the whole run. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than true 100%: roughly 60% of everything, any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, and any 70 of 80 challenges. The only parts that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see what is left.
Do any 100 optional missions (purple icons and black icons with pink letters).
Scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app.
Study any 100 of 255 animals through binoculars.
Complete any 70 of 80 challenges.
Finish every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and you can mix them freely. Under-the-bridges runs are the quickest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Pick the quickest category first: fly under bridges (202 of them).
Mix in stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps to reach 250.
Track by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most of these happen naturally while working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types are still missing.
Do one of each: fish, hunt, golf, shoot a range, play pool, score a basketball hoop, finish a video game, win a race, do a stunt.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find them.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold medals are not very difficult, and ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger. There is a dedicated locations guide for all 12 ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges (one per range setup).

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total). Every location counts toward the 100% checklist too, so this is not extra work.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win one race at each location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the easiest 20. Races also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Pick 20 race locations from the 40 on the map.
Win one race at each of them.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Finish Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text with the purple fishing marker.
Follow the questline and beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Complete one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must finish all levels of one game at least once; beating every challenge is not required. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Go to the TV at home (or an arcade machine for Bang For Your Buck).
Pick one of the 4 games and finish all its levels once.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, wait for Andy's call and text (Belville).
Complete the 5 Andy quests in order.
The final quest, Puff Puff Pass, pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), when he calls and is marked with the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks: follow the purple chest markers, use the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring each treasure back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (calling Brian as Jason speeds it up), so nothing is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: After Island Dreams, wait for Kenton's call (green KR icon, Key Lento).
Dive the 7 shipwreck sites and bring each treasure back.
Turn in each set; he calls you back for the next one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub (Kelly County).
Complete the 5 Billy quests in order.
The final quest, Hometown Heroes, pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Only certain questlines count: Kirk the Skunk Ape hunter (3 quests), Kyle at McKittrick Farm (3 quests), Yago the street racer (4 quests) and Pilot Pete (5 delivery quests) are confirmed. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. All strangers stay available after the story in free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Do Kirk's 3 quests (Skunk Ape, tree effigies, Mr. Mangrove).
Do Kyle's 3 quests at McKittrick Farm.
Do Yago's 4 street-racing quests.
Do Pilot Pete's delivery quests.
Any 8 of these strands pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted, then drive it back in good condition for more money. Cars show up often in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. This can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 (steal the Zorrusso).
Check Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List for the 16 cars.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK; deliver each wanted one to Randy's garage.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which pops the trophy when you shut the labs down. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty (Jason), follow the purple Synthetic Labs markers.
Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter.
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME: the first meditation happens during Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, and it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy — the author of the guide had done it when the trophy popped. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The final meditation needs the both-characters ability, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: CHAPTER 1 — DO THIS FIRST: after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning.
When she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
Meditate at the other 17 spots (10 locations), with both characters where possible.
The last spot needs the both-characters ability (after Coffee Break).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason about the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. There are 15 Target Decks in total, all needed for the 100% checklist. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: After Coffee Break (Jason), wait for Bret's text (Veteran Hunted, Lummox County).
Hunt the animals Bret requests and bring them to him.
Work through the 15 Target Decks.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. There is a dedicated locations guide for all 18 sets. For the 100% checklist you need 15 full sets, so this trophy comes on the way.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Find cards across Leonida (18 sets in total).
Complete any 3 full sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up and R1 on objects in the world. There are more than 100 (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags), so scan whichever you pass. Scanning vehicles and animals with the same app also feeds other trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Hold Up + R1 to WAiNK-scan objects as you travel.
Scan any 100: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or tags.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Many complete naturally while working on other trophies; save this for the cleanup phase and pick the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Work on other trophies first; challenges pile up naturally.
Check Progress > Challenges for what is left.
Pick the 50 easiest to finish.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need your partner beside you, which is possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (call them with hold Right + Triangle). Get a 4-star wanted level by causing chaos, then escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. A fast sports motorcycle helps. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since large bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars.
Escape through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, then leave the red heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping the red/blue flashing wanted level — do not let it drop to the red heat level or clear entirely. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, so if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and leave before the police arrive.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and gear up (vest, sticky bombs).
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level.
Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not pop, hit a fourth.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan). There are 557 vehicles at launch. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; you only need to scan them, not drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles, so this pops on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app on a busy road.
Scan every new vehicle you see until you hit 100.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. You must down 5 enemies in one use, so buff your focus first with food, drinks or a wash, and take Adrenaline to stretch the time. Line up 5 enemies — criminals at Gang Operations are ideal — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Wear body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); raise it with shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. At Focus level 4 this comes much more easily.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Buff focus (food/drinks/Adrenaline) and wear body armor.
Find 5 criminals together at a Gang Operation.
Trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and drop all 5 before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside. Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and drive through a fence to the E3/E4 terminal plane.
Board via the stairs by the boarding bridge; enter the cockpit.
Reverse to the airstrip, take off, and fly 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island, Mariana County).
Enter through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a Rhino tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies. Then break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun for the silent approach (kicking the door triggers the alarm). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe.

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and open the vault, then rob it — bring your partner and hand off a bag with hold Right. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons) once you have done his Payday Loan quests. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognized. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this silver pops on the way. A single vault pays up to $205,000, the best money in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4) to unlock vault robberies.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000) after his Payday Loan quests.
Tail vans, rob 5 vaults, and escape the 4-star heat each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically during the same Chapter 4 mission, That's Where The Money Is…, because robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also get it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door (sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests) and blow it open — but the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Do That's Where The Money Is… and rob the bank vault (counts as the truck).
Or: block an armored truck, sticky-bomb its back door, loot it.
Escape the red heat radius to pop it.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the entire map is visible. There is a dedicated unfogging guide with the best plane to use.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane.
Fly over every fogged area until the map is fully revealed.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this pops on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you get near them, and many get marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Watch for yellow operation icons on the map.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track progress under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the unlock is almost certainly tied to a specific bar or spot there, but no verified method has been published yet. This guide will not invent one: check the sources below for updates before spending time on it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Method unconfirmed as of this guide's sources.
Try cocktail spots with a view on Ocean Beach.
Check the PowerPyx guide for updates before grinding it.
trophies.unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this method as currently unknown.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown. The description points to smashing a car out of a vehicle showroom, but no verified method has been published yet. This guide will not invent one: check the sources below for updates.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Method unconfirmed as of this guide's sources.
Likely: drive a car through a showroom's glass front.
Check the PowerPyx guide for updates before grinding it.
trophies.unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this method as currently unknown.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs, bought at Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for what is left — it is not missable, and you do not need all 3 in one go.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first.
At Kingpin Bowling (Port Gellhorn): take the luxury watch (SE office).
Take the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (NE table).
Blow the safe in the NE hallway office with sticky bombs.
Escape the police to pop it.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always go together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while one character actively works out, the other completes training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Coffee Break, join a fitness club.
Always work out with your partner beside you (call with hold Right + Triangle).
Raise both characters' strength to maximum.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a little demon face appears whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (permanent, from excessive violence). Most of it happens passively while working on other trophies — every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car (note: at Psycho or Irredeemable, cops shoot on sight more often).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD).
Play normally: robberies and fights count toward the 500.
If short at the end, farm profile actions by running over pedestrians.

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. This guide will not invent a method: check the sources below for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Method unconfirmed as of this guide's sources.
Leading belief: tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Check the PowerPyx guide for updates before grinding it.
trophies.unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this method as currently unknown (believed related to the Payday Loans store).

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. This guide will not invent a method: check the sources below for updates.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Method unconfirmed as of this guide's sources.
Leading belief: tied to a UFO questline.
Check the PowerPyx guide for updates before grinding it.
trophies.unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this method as currently unknown (believed UFO questline).

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. This guide will not invent a method: check the sources below for updates.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Method unconfirmed as of this guide's sources.
Leading belief: kick enemies while driving a motorcycle.
Check the PowerPyx guide for updates before grinding it.
trophies.unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this method as currently unknown (believed motorcycle melee kicks).

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip, and it comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but only unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 total to a fence (Yasmani pays most).

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. It counts cumulatively and comes naturally: weapons, ammo, clothes, food and vehicles all count. If you are short at the end, buy the most expensive items you can find until the total crosses $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Shop normally through the story and cleanup.
Track the running total in your head against $100,000.
Top it up with big purchases if short.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. They become available as you explore and earn money; bank vault robberies (up to $205,000 each) are the fastest way to fund them. Garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Earn money (bank vaults pay best).
Buy each of the 8 garage properties when they appear.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register any 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, then register each one through the app. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles) and Little Boxes (garages to store them in).
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find 10 vehicles you want to keep.
Register each one through the Scooter Bros app.
